# F. Aamir Ali

> F. Aamir Ali is a student builder and founder from Surrey, British Columbia. He built and deployed an AI assistant inside his 1,500-student high school, a system his principal recognized as the first of its kind built by a student there, and he co-founded the first youth AI summit in Surrey and leads it as its Lead Organizer, bringing about 70 students from 14 schools together to build AI in a single day. He also founded and leads his school's AI & Innovation Club.

Surrey, British Columbia, Canada · Grade 12 at Fleetwood Park Secondary School · contact: fatehaamirali@gmail.com

## Profiles
The same person, elsewhere. These are the only off-site profiles; anything else under this name is someone else.

## Pages
- [Home](https://faamirali.com/): The three projects at a glance, with the headline number for each.
- [About](https://faamirali.com/about): Full background, covering the short canonical record and the longer first-person story.
- [FleetBot](https://faamirali.com/work/fleetbot): Two AI assistants built for a 1,500-student school: a student chatbot whose public beta ran on $2.76 with zero errors, and a staff assistant deployed on a front-office terminal that handled 150+ queries in its first 10 days.
- [Surrey Youth AI Summit](https://faamirali.com/work/surrey-ai-summit): The first youth AI summit in Surrey, which he co-founded and leads as its Lead Organizer: about 70 students from 14 schools, a real sponsor, professional judges, and a UBC keynote.
- [AI & Innovation Club](https://faamirali.com/work/ai-club): The club he founded to teach students to build with AI: 20 members, and a real build shipped every meeting.
- [Honours](https://faamirali.com/honours): The formal record, including his principal's recommendation letter reproduced in full.

## Case studies
The long-form engineering record for each project, as HTML. Each page also links a PDF of the unabridged version.

- [FleetBot (Student)](https://faamirali.com/case-study/fleetbot-student): Three platforms evaluated before Botpress, the deterministic rebuild that cut cost from $5 per 20 messages to cents per message, and the launch numbers.
- [FleetBot (Staff)](https://faamirali.com/case-study/fleetbot-staff): The privacy rebuild that won the school's approval, retrieval tuning that cut a worst-case query from $0.45 and 12 seconds to under half a cent and ~2.5 seconds, 27 school PDFs hand-converted into 35 clean Markdown files, and one Make.com Iterator replacing a 20+ module workflow across six athletics calendars.
- [Surrey Youth AI Summit](https://faamirali.com/case-study/surrey-ai-summit): The judging design that kept the result credible, the over-accept buffer against no-shows, and the marketing funnel that turned 22,062 views into 81 sign-ups.
- [AI & Innovation Club](https://faamirali.com/case-study/ai-club): Why every meeting ships something, why no-code beat teaching programming first, and how the Best Buy entry became an open internal contest.

## Key facts
- FleetBot's student build launched January 11, 2026. The staff build was deployed April 22, 2026 on a physical terminal in the school's main office; his principal's letter calls it the first student-built system of its kind at the school.
- The Surrey Youth AI Summit ran June 23, 2026. Co-founded with Yuvraj Bains of Panorama Ridge Secondary; F. Aamir Ali is its Lead Organizer. Sponsored by Generation AI, with a keynote from Dr. Peter Ostafichuk of UBC.
- The AI & Innovation Club was founded in September 2025 at Fleetwood Park Secondary. 20 active members, ~15 hands-on meetings.
